assistant.title: Farm Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask about your farm in plain words — answers come from your own records
assistant.placeholder: Ask a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
assistant.empty_title: What would you like to know?
assistant.empty_hint: The assistant only reads data you are allowed to see. It never changes anything.
assistant.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
assistant.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes — check important figures on their pages.

suggestions.s1: How much did we spend this month, and on what?
suggestions.s2: What was last month's profit or loss?
suggestions.s3: How much milk did we get in the last 7 days?
suggestions.s4: Which vaccines are due in the next two weeks?
suggestions.s5: Who owes us money, and how much?
suggestions.s6: Which medicines or feeds are running low?

off.title: AI is switched off
off.hint: Open Settings → AI, switch it on and add the key of the AI service you use.
off.ask_admin: Ask an administrator to turn it on.

reports.title: Monthly AI Reports
reports.subtitle: A short summary of each month, written from the farm's figures
reports.empty: No reports yet. They are written automatically on the 1st of each month, or pick a month and write one now.
reports.schedule_hint: Written automatically at 9:00 on the 1st of every month for the previous month.

receipt.hint: Photo or PDF of a memo/invoice, up to 5 MB
receipt.filled: Filled from the receipt — check every field before saving.

settings.title: AI
settings.subtitle: Farm assistant, receipt reading and monthly reports — with Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT or another AI service
settings.api_key_saved: Saved: {{hint}} — leave blank to keep it
settings.api_key_help: It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.chat_model_hint: Answers questions and writes the monthly report.
settings.vision_model_hint: Reads receipt photos; it must be able to see images.
settings.budget_hint: AI stops for the rest of the month when this is reached.

feature_hint.assistant: Chat that answers from the farm's records (read-only).
feature_hint.receipt_scan: Fill the expense form from a receipt photo.
feature_hint.monthly_report: Written on the 1st of each month; WhatsApp recipients with the "Monthly report" alert get it.
feature_hint.voice_entry: Say milk, weight, illness, heat or a small expense; check it, then save.

settings.no_usage: No AI use this month yet.
settings.privacy_text: Only the figures needed for each question are sent to the chosen AI service. Claude, Gemini and OpenAI do not train on paid API data; check the terms of any other service. Keys are kept encrypted on your server.
settings.connection_hint: Pick the service to use. Each keeps its own key, so you can switch back any time.
settings.base_url_hint: The address that ends in /v1. Examples:
settings.custom_price_hint: We have no price list for this model. Enter its price (US$ per million tokens) so the monthly budget is counted — or 0 for a free/local model.
settings.show_in_menu: Show AI in the side menu
settings.show_in_menu_hint: Off: the AI group (assistant, monthly reports) disappears from everyone's menu. Receipt reading and the scheduled report keep working.
settings.super_admin_only: Only a Super Admin can change this.
settings.show_in_menu_instant: Saved as soon as you switch it.

voice_audio.transcribe: This service turns recordings into text first.
voice_audio.none: This service cannot hear audio: the browser writes down the words (Chrome/Edge), or type.

settings.whatsapp_elsewhere: Set up on the WhatsApp page, together with the alerts.

voice.title: Voice Entry
voice.subtitle: Say what happened on the farm — check what was understood, then save
voice.mic_blocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in the browser and try again.
voice.record_failed: The recording could not be read. Please try again.
voice.dictation_failed: The browser could not take dictation. Please type instead.
voice.no_mic: This browser cannot use the microphone here — type the entry below.
voice.dictate_hint: The browser writes down your words; check the text, then press "Understand".
voice.placeholder: e.g. C-005 gave 12 kg milk this morning, C-003 did not eat today

examples.e1: C-005 gave 12 kg milk this morning
examples.e2: C-003 did not eat today, has a fever
examples.e4: Paid 1500 taka for the electricity bill

voice.is_question: This sounds like a question, not an entry.
voice.nothing: Nothing to record was found. Try saying the tag and what happened.
voice.save_hint: Nothing is saved until you press Save.
voice.fix_first: Fix or remove the entries marked in red first.

automation.title: WhatsApp automation
automation.hint: Staff write or send a voice note to this WhatsApp number: entries are read back and saved only after they reply "yes"; questions are answered from the farm's data.
automation.whatsapp_missing: Set up the connection above first.
automation.step1: In the Webhook section above, also subscribe to the "messages" field in Meta's app.
automation.step2: Add each person's WhatsApp number on their user profile (Users). Their role decides what they may do.
automation.step3: Switch the automation on. Anyone else who writes gets one short reply a day and nothing more.
automation.no_users: No user has a WhatsApp number yet. Messages from unknown numbers get one short reply a day and nothing else.
automation.free_note: Replies go out as plain text right after the person writes, inside the 24-hour window — Meta does not charge for them. AI use counts against the monthly budget.
automation.ai_missing: AI is not switched on or set up yet — the automation needs it to read messages.
automation.voice_yes: Voice notes are understood with the current AI service.
automation.voice_no: The current AI service cannot hear voice notes — typed messages work. For voice, choose Gemini or OpenAI in AI settings.
